title.zh-CN: 发热、广泛皮疹与黄疸 · 29岁女性
title.en: Fever, widespread rash and jaundice · woman aged 29

summary.zh-CN: 持续服药后出现皮肤和肝脏损害，时间线及既往同药反应是关键。
summary.en: Skin and liver injury after sustained medication exposure requires a precise timeline and prior reaction history.

question.en: Have you had a rash from the same pain medicine before? What happened when the earlier culprit medicine was stopped?

answer.en: Penicillin was given for two days after fever and rash had begun; both drugs were then stopped.

answer.en: Four days after withdrawal and treatment, fever persisted and skin injury/jaundice worsened.

text.zh-CN: 原报告激素及多种支持药后改善，但第25天再发热黄疸；后来逐渐恢复，约第38天肝功能正常，停药后一年无复发。单例不能分离各药效果。
text.en: Steroids and multiple supportive drugs were followed by improvement, but fever/jaundice recurred on day 25. Liver tests normalised around day 38 and no recurrence was reported over one year. Individual drug effects cannot be isolated.

feedback.en: Latency, prior same-drug rash and multi-system disease support this.

text.en: Later penicillin use establishes it as the only cause

text.zh-CN: 只是湿疹，无需关注肝脏

feedback.en: Falling prothrombin activity and ascites are serious, without inventing encephalopathy.

feedback.zh-CN: 不将历史保肝药组合视为已证实方案。

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.

unknowns.zh-CN: 完整RegiSCAR、HHV6、INR、脑病记录和过敏专科复核。
unknowns.en: Complete RegiSCAR, HHV6, INR, encephalopathy documentation and allergy specialist review.
